name: Industry Next Services

brief_fields: what should be working in 90 days

positioning: A senior build studio for working AI products, media formats, commerce systems, cultural tools, and organizational workflows.

deliverables: Opportunity map with up to 12 ranked moves
One shipped public or private prototype
Measurement plan, governance, and risk register
90-day build plan with owners and budget bands
Source files, runbook, team handoff, and 30 days of post-launch care

packages.name: AI Format Lab
packages.outcome: A repeatable audience format the client team can produce again.

packages.name: Launch System
packages.outcome: A working demonstration and one launch story with receipts.

packages.name: Growth Operating System
packages.outcome: A connected offer, Shopify journey, content system, and operating dashboard.

packages.name: Store as Media
packages.outcome: A storefront and publishing system that teaches the next campaign.

packages.name: High-Consequence AI Pilot
packages.outcome: A bounded, human-reviewed pilot with evidence, evaluation, and stop-scale gates.

packages.name: Personal and Cultural Studio
packages.sector: individuals, artists, archives, and cultural organizations
packages.outcome: A distinct personal system or public cultural object with source and stewardship.

operating_principles: use the smallest safe data boundary
leave source, owners, and a team that can run the next cycle
do not train on private client material by default
